title: Is there documentation on how to import and build xDrip
body:
I pulled the project from Github, opened it with the latest version from IntelliJ community (IntelliJ IDEA 2018.2.8).
After build, I chose: Build Artifacts, but this keeps resulting in:
Error:java: invalid target release: x (where x is a version, e.g. 11)
Questions about import:
Is there any documentation?
Should I use the standard Gradle wrapper or custom?

comments.body:
I think that most people use android studio to build xdrip.
You can also write gradlew assembledebug from command line to build it.

I decided to go with Android Studio, but even this one fails:
error: cannot find symbol class Models
error: package UtilityModels does not exist
error: package Models.ProcessInitialDataQuality does not exist
error: package UtilityModels does not exist
etc.

Do I have to do clone more then master from https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip.git?
As mentioned already, use Android Studio. I'm on 4.1.1 and it works pretty well.
